IF OBJECT_ID(N'RedGateSchema.CountRecentAudits','FN') IS NOT NULL DROP FUNCTION RedGateSchema.CountRecentAudits;
EXEC(N' CREATE FUNCTION RedGateSchema.CountRecentAudits (@Days INT) RETURNS INT AS BEGIN RETURN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RedGateSchema.FeedbackAudit a WHERE a.CreatedAt > DATEADD(day, -@Days, SYSUTCDATETIME()) ); END ');
